description: Frozen77 policy migration mechanism models, 10 existing fixed inputs x 9 modes x 4 arms =360. First-run cohort stratification uses past completed first-run lengths and already-observed recurrence only; RAM-admit uses current observed prefix. Spill postpones admission until actual 2-object RAM eviction. NoHotspot exactly unchanged in H-only candidates; common_* modes deliberately apply the same executor change to all arms and compare their resulting Full/NoH. H-only RAM-trigger controls are diagnostics and cannot establish H-specific contribution. Fixed additive cost is not walltime/p99. All arms, inputs and traces retained.
